classes.external: outside-standard token; verbatim canonical form (ISO 4217, BCP 47, rating scheme)
classes.vocab: CC-defined vocabulary; MUST match vocab_pattern; refuse, never fold
classes.wildcard: the `*` tail; not a segment value; VARIADIC — matches one or more remaining segments (CIRISConstitution#108)

rating.standard: the scheme named in the sibling {scheme} segment

unit.standard: ISO 4217 code, or a unit the ledger declares

case_rule.policy: case-sensitive; lowercase CC vocabulary; per-segment classes

version_segment.note: Every scored dimension carries exactly one trailing version segment after its family's own segments; a row whose last segment is `{version}` names that segment. Matching strips it; a consumer keys the rule version from it. Families in `exempt` need none — a tail is tolerated, never required (mechanism-named attestation ladder; the canonical-binding hash).

wildcard_rule.note: A family ending in `*` covers every dimension sharing its stem segments with at least one further segment: `accord:*` covers `accord:invoke:notify:{notify_id}`. A consumer that requires len(segments) == len(parts) for a wildcard family has misread the registry. The segments below the wildcard are classed by the leaf's own row where one exists, else `vocab` unless the leaf row says otherwise.
